Professional Experience  
As a Staff Product Manager at CyberShield Dynamics, I lead the development of enterprise threat detection platforms, driving 25% YoY revenue growth through strategic product positioning. Prior to this, I spearheaded the launch of ThreatLogix’s threat intelligence platform, which reduced customer onboarding time by 40% and achieved 90% customer retention within six months. At VulnerabilityX, I optimized internal workflows using SQL analytics, cutting manual reporting time by 40% while improving data accuracy. My early role as Product Analyst at SecureNet Solutions laid the foundation for cross-functional collaboration, where I introduced data visualization tools that accelerated stakeholder decision-making by 30%.

Competitive analysis: Identified a market gap in real-time threat detection, leading to the development of a flagship feature that captured 15% of the cybersecurity SaaS market within 18 months. Cross-team collaboration: Orchestrated partnerships between engineering, sales, and security teams to align roadmap priorities, resulting in a 30% increase in feature adoption. Data visualization (Tableau/Power BI): Built interactive dashboards for executive reporting, enabling data-driven decisions that reduced operational costs by $200K annually. Roadmap planning: Aligned product vision with C-suite stakeholders to prioritize high-impact initiatives, ensuring 85% of roadmap items met business KPIs. SQL analytics: Queryed and aggregated terabytes of user data to identify usage patterns, informing product refinements that boosted user engagement by 20%. Stakeholder communication: Translated technical specifications into business value narratives, securing $1.2M in budget approvals for R&D initiatives. Stakeholder management: Managed a 12-person cross-functional team across three time zones, ensuring seamless coordination during product launches. Analytics-driven product decisions: Integrated A/B testing frameworks to validate feature hypotheses, reducing development risk by 35% and increasing feature success rates by 25%. Product management: Architectured a scalable product framework that supported rapid iteration, enabling the team to release 12 major updates in 12 months.
